name: SOURCE_PIN
entry_requirement: Frozen fixture/Atlas/TOC hashes and candidate crosswalk pinned
responsible_review: Human editorial owner verifies source manifest; provenance
exit_criteria: BLOCKED until reviewer accepts candidate authoring baseline

name: SCOPE
entry_requirement: Chapter scope/contract and typed references complete
exit_criteria: Reject missing chapter owner and known map contradictions

name: AUTOMATED_LINT
entry_requirement: Critical and major mechanical checks pass

name: SEMANTIC_REVIEW
entry_requirement: Security, authority, claim grade and fixture narrative independently checked

name: CROSS_CHAPTER
entry_requirement: Paired authors compare overlapping concepts and explicitly record deltas

name: EDITORIAL
entry_requirement: Template, teaching uniqueness, figures, citations and rights accepted
exit_criteria: Chapter acceptance signed under existing operating system

name: PUBLICATION
entry_requirement: Reproducible evidence package, immutable source versions and approved release
